# Review package template

## Candidate and outcome

- Task and investor-visible behavior:
- Run mode, fit-assessment outcome, actual conversation title and next-task pointer:
- For decomposition: child plan/first ready child and confirmation no implementation began:
- Exact commit/revision and artifact hash, or explicit no-Git state with changed-file manifest:
- Environment and data/fixture identity:
- Scope completed and exclusions:

## Acceptance evidence

| Criterion | Observed result | Evidence | Remaining limitation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Concrete criterion | Pass / fail / not run | Actual check output, fixture or manual observation | Any unresolved dependency |

## Verification and findings

- Checks actually run and results:
- Checks not run and why:
- Independent review scope/findings and resolution:
- Tax/risk/data assumptions, source versions and unsupported cases:
- Privacy, dependency, data-rights and operational issues:
- Regression, migration and recovery evidence:

## Manual acceptance

Give a short repeatable script, expected visible outcomes and the synthetic dataset. Distinguish engineering verification from owner acceptance. Record actual acceptance only when it happens.

## Next action

State whether work is ready for review, accepted, or released. For any unresolved consequential approval, identify the exact artifact, destination/use, operations, remaining risk and recovery path. Do not request authorization for routine work already covered by the task.
